intro: 前几章在**一个**频率下求正弦稳态；本章把 ω 当作变量，看电路的响应怎样随频率变化。核心工具是**网络函数** H(jω) = 响应相量/激励相量：它的模给出幅频特性，辐角给出相频特性。滤波器（低通、高通、带通）和谐振都是从 H(jω) 读出来的。

en.intro: Earlier chapters solved the sinusoidal steady state at **one** frequency; here ω becomes a variable and we ask how the response changes with frequency. The central tool is the **network function** H(jω) = response phasor / excitation phasor: its magnitude gives the amplitude response, its angle the phase response. Filters (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass) and resonance are all read off H(jω).

ideas.title: 网络函数 H(jω)：幅频与相频特性
text: 单一正弦激励下，网络函数 H(jω) = \frac{响应相量}{激励相量}（例如 U̇_o/U̇_s）。它与激励的大小、初相无关，只由电路结构、参数和 ω 决定。|H(jω)| 随 ω 变化的曲线是**幅频特性**，arg H(jω) 是**相频特性**。
求法：用相量法（阻抗、分压、分流、结点法）把输出写成输入的倍数，再整理成标准形式，看 ω → 0 和 ω → ∞ 的极限判断类型。增益常用分贝表示：20lg|H| dB；|H| = 1/√2 对应 −3 dB。
多节级联时，后一节会从前一节取电流（**负载效应**），总的 H **不等于**各节单独开路时 H 的乘积；只有中间加了电压跟随器等隔离时才能直接相乘。

en.title: The network function H(jω): amplitude and phase response
text: For a single sinusoidal input the network function is H(jω) = \frac{response phasor}{excitation phasor} (e.g. U̇_o/U̇_s). It does not depend on the input's size or phase, only on the circuit, its values and ω. |H(jω)| against ω is the **amplitude (magnitude) response**, arg H(jω) the **phase response**.

To find it: use phasor methods (impedances, dividers, nodal analysis) to write the output as a multiple of the input, put it in a standard form, and look at the limits ω → 0 and ω → ∞ to see what kind of filter it is. Gain is often given in decibels, 20lg|H| dB; |H| = 1/√2 is −3 dB.

When sections are cascaded, the second draws current from the first (the **loading effect**), so the overall H is **not** the product of the sections' open-circuit H; only with isolation (e.g. a voltage follower in between) do they multiply.

ideas.title: 一阶低通、高通与截止频率
text: RC 电路输出取电容电压是**低通**：H = \frac{1}{1 + jωRC}；RL 电路输出取电感电压是**高通**：H = \frac{jωL}{R + jωL}。一般地，一阶电路的转折（截止）角频率 ω_c = 1/τ，τ = R_{eq}C 或 L/R_eq。
**截止频率**定义为 |H| 降到最大值的 1/√2（比通带低 3 dB）的频率，也叫**半功率点**。在 ω_c 处一阶低通的相位为 −45°，一阶高通为 +45°。
R_eq 是**从储能元件两端看进去**的戴维宁等效电阻（独立源置零）。输出端接了负载电阻时，R_eq 和通带增益都会变——这是无源滤波器的缺点。

en.title: First-order low-pass, high-pass and the cut-off frequency
text: An RC circuit with the output across C is a **low-pass**: H = \frac{1}{1 + jωRC}; an RL circuit with the output across L is a **high-pass**: H = \frac{jωL}{R + jωL}. In general a first-order circuit's corner (cut-off) angular frequency is ω_c = 1/τ, with τ = R_{eq}C or L/R_eq.

The **cut-off frequency** is where |H| has dropped to 1/√2 of its maximum (3 dB below the passband), also called the **half-power point**. There a first-order low-pass has phase −45°, a high-pass +45°.

R_eq is the Thévenin resistance **seen from the terminals of the storage element** (independent sources zeroed). A load resistor at the output changes both R_eq and the passband gain — the drawback of passive filters.

ideas.title: RLC 串联谐振
text: 串联 RLC 的阻抗 Z = R + j(ωL − \frac{1}{ωC})。虚部为零时电压与电流同相，称为**谐振**：ω_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}，f_0 = \frac{ω_0}{2π}。
谐振时 |Z| = R 最小，电流 I = U_s/R 最大；U̇_L 与 U̇_C 大小相等、相位相反、互相抵消，L、C 串联部分相当于短路。
**品质因数** Q = \frac{ω_0L}{R} = \frac{1}{ω_0CR} = \frac{1}{R}\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}}；谐振时 U_L = U_C = QU_s，Q 很大时会出现远高于电源电压的“过电压”（电压谐振）。调节 C 使回路对某一频率谐振，就是收音机的**调谐**。

en.title: Series RLC resonance
text: A series RLC has Z = R + j(ωL − \frac{1}{ωC}). When the imaginary part vanishes voltage and current are in phase: **resonance**, at ω_0 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}, f_0 = \frac{ω_0}{2π}.
At resonance |Z| = R is minimal and the current I = U_s/R maximal; U̇_L and U̇_C are equal in size and opposite in phase, so they cancel and the L–C part acts as a short circuit.

The **quality factor** is Q = \frac{ω_0L}{R} = \frac{1}{ω_0CR} = \frac{1}{R}\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}}; at resonance U_L = U_C = QU_s, so a high-Q circuit shows voltages far above the source (voltage resonance). Adjusting C to resonate at one station's frequency is how a radio is **tuned**.

ideas.title: 带通特性与通频带
text: 串联 RLC 的输出取电阻电压时 H = \frac{R}{R + j(ωL − 1/(ωC))}，谐振时 H = 1，偏离 ω_0 越远越小：**带通**。
|H| = 1/√2 时 |ωL − 1/(ωC)| = R，得到两个半功率频率 ω_1 < ω_0 < ω_2，满足 ω_1ω_2 = ω_0²（ω_0 是它们的几何平均）。**通频带** BW = ω_2 − ω_1 = R/L = ω_0/Q。
Q 越大，通频带越窄、选择性越好。注意题目要求带宽用 rad/s 还是 Hz：BW_{Hz} = BW_{rad/s}/(2π)。

en.title: Band-pass behaviour and bandwidth
text: A series RLC with the output across R has H = \frac{R}{R + j(ωL − 1/(ωC))}: H = 1 at resonance and smaller the further ω is from ω_0 — a **band-pass**.
|H| = 1/√2 where |ωL − 1/(ωC)| = R, which gives two half-power frequencies ω_1 < ω_0 < ω_2 with ω_1ω_2 = ω_0² (ω_0 is their geometric mean). The **bandwidth** is BW = ω_2 − ω_1 = R/L = ω_0/Q.
Higher Q means a narrower band and better selectivity. Check whether the bandwidth is wanted in rad/s or Hz: BW_{Hz} = BW_{rad/s}/(2π).

ideas.title: GCL 并联谐振
text: 并联电路用导纳：Y = G + j(ωC − \frac{1}{ωL})。虚部为零时谐振，ω_0 = 1/\sqrt{LC}；此时 |Y| = G 最小、|Z| = R 最大，电流源激励下端电压 U = I_s/G 最大。
谐振时 L、C 支路电流大小相等、相位相反，L∥C 部分相当于**开路**；Q = \frac{R}{ω_0L} = ω_0RC，I_L = I_C = QI_s（电流谐振）。通频带 BW = \frac{G}{C} = \frac{1}{RC}。
电压源带内阻 R_s 驱动并联回路时，先化成诺顿等效（电流源 U_s/R_s 并 R_s）：内阻并在回路上，使总电导增大、**有载 Q 下降、通带变宽**。

en.title: Parallel GCL resonance
text: Use admittance for a parallel circuit: Y = G + j(ωC − \frac{1}{ωL}). Resonance where the imaginary part vanishes, ω_0 = 1/\sqrt{LC}; then |Y| = G is minimal, |Z| = R maximal, and with a current source the voltage U = I_s/G is maximal.

At resonance the L and C currents are equal and opposite, so the L∥C pair acts as an **open circuit**; Q = \frac{R}{ω_0L} = ω_0RC and I_L = I_C = QI_s (current resonance). The bandwidth is BW = \frac{G}{C} = \frac{1}{RC}.

When a voltage source with internal resistance R_s drives the tank, convert it to its Norton form (U_s/R_s in parallel with R_s): R_s appears across the tank, raising the total conductance, so the **loaded Q drops and the band widens**.

ideas.title: 实际线圈与电容并联
text: 实际线圈是 R 与 L 串联，它和电容并联时**不能**直接套 1/\sqrt{LC}。写导纳 Y = jωC + \frac{R − jωL}{R^{2} + ω^{2}L^{2}}，令虚部为零：C = \frac{L}{R^{2} + ω_0^{2}L^{2}}，即 ω_0 = \sqrt{\frac{1}{LC} − \frac{R^{2}}{L^{2}}}（要求 R < \sqrt{L/C}）。
谐振时端口阻抗为纯电阻 Z_0 = \frac{L}{RC}；线圈电流的无功分量被电容电流抵消，所以线圈电流可以比电源电流大。

en.title: A real coil in parallel with a capacitor
text: A real coil is R in series with L; in parallel with a capacitor you **cannot** just use 1/\sqrt{LC}. Write Y = jωC + \frac{R − jωL}{R^{2} + ω^{2}L^{2}} and set the imaginary part to zero: C = \frac{L}{R^{2} + ω_0^{2}L^{2}}, i.e. ω_0 = \sqrt{\frac{1}{LC} − \frac{R^{2}}{L^{2}}} (requires R < \sqrt{L/C}).

At resonance the port impedance is purely resistive, Z_0 = \frac{L}{RC}; the reactive part of the coil current is cancelled by the capacitor current, so the coil current can exceed the source current.

ideas.title: 串、并联谐振组合的选频电路
text: L∥C 在 ω_p = 1/\sqrt{LC} 时阻抗 → ∞（**阻断**该频率，陷波）；低于 ω_p 时呈感性，高于 ω_p 时呈容性。呈感性的 L∥C 再和一个电容串联，可在另一个频率发生串联谐振（阻抗最小，**导通**）。
分析方法：先写出总阻抗，分别令其虚部为零（串联谐振）或令某并联部分的导纳为零（并联谐振）。一个电路可以有多个谐振频率，题目问“最低谐振频率”时要逐个比较。

en.title: Frequency-selective circuits combining series and parallel resonance
text: L∥C has infinite impedance at ω_p = 1/\sqrt{LC} (it **blocks** that frequency — a notch); below ω_p it is inductive, above it capacitive. An inductive L∥C in series with a capacitor can resonate in series at another frequency (minimum impedance — it **passes** that frequency).

Method: write the total impedance and set its imaginary part to zero (series resonance), or a parallel part's admittance to zero (parallel resonance). A circuit can have several resonant frequencies; for “the lowest” compare them all.

ideas.title: op-amp 构成的一阶有源滤波器
text: 理想 op-amp（运算放大器）的反相放大器公式对阻抗同样成立：H(jω) = −\frac{Z_f}{Z_1}。反馈支路 R_f∥C_f 给出**低通** H = −\frac{R_f}{R_1}·\frac{1}{1 + jωR_fC_f}；输入支路 R_1 串 C_1 给出**高通** H = −\frac{R_f}{R_1}·\frac{jωR_1C_1}{1 + jωR_1C_1}；两者都有就是**带通**。
转折频率由与电容相关的那一个 RC 决定（低通 1/(R_fC_f)，高通 1/(R_1C_1)），通带增益为 −R_f/R_1。反相放大器的相位要多加 180°。
有源滤波器的输出由 op-amp 驱动，接负载不改变 H，通带增益可以大于 1；输入阻抗就是 Z_1（反相端虚地）。

en.title: First-order active filters with op-amps
text: The ideal inverting amplifier formula holds for impedances too: H(jω) = −\frac{Z_f}{Z_1}. A feedback R_f∥C_f gives a **low-pass** H = −\frac{R_f}{R_1}·\frac{1}{1 + jωR_fC_f}; an input branch R_1 in series with C_1 gives a **high-pass** H = −\frac{R_f}{R_1}·\frac{jωR_1C_1}{1 + jωR_1C_1}; both together make a **band-pass**.

The corner frequency comes from the RC that contains the capacitor (1/(R_fC_f) for the low-pass, 1/(R_1C_1) for the high-pass); the passband gain is −R_f/R_1. The inverting amplifier adds 180° to the phase.
An active filter's output is driven by the op-amp, so a load does not change H and the passband gain can exceed 1; the input impedance is just Z_1 (virtual ground).

formulas.name: 网络函数
formulas.when: 单一正弦激励的正弦稳态；与激励大小无关。|H| = 1/√2 ↔ −3 dB。

en.name: Network function
en.when: Sinusoidal steady state with a single sinusoidal input; independent of the input's size. |H| = 1/√2 ↔ −3 dB.

formulas.name: 一阶 RC 低通
formulas.when: 输出取电容电压且输出端开路；接负载时用从 C 看进去的 R_eq，并乘以直流分压比。

en.name: First-order RC low-pass
en.when: Output across C, output open; with a load use the R_eq seen by C and multiply by the DC divider ratio.

formulas.name: 一阶 RL 高通
formulas.when: 输出取电感电压且开路。ω = ω_c 时 |H| = 1/√2，相位 +45°。

en.name: First-order RL high-pass
en.when: Output across L, open. At ω = ω_c, |H| = 1/√2 and the phase is +45°.

formulas.name: 一阶电路的截止角频率
formulas.when: R_eq 为从 C（或 L）两端看进去的等效电阻，独立源置零。

en.name: Cut-off of a first-order circuit
en.when: R_eq is the resistance seen from the terminals of C (or L), independent sources zeroed.

formulas.name: 串联谐振频率
formulas.when: 理想 RLC 串联（或理想 GCL 并联）；谐振时 Z（或 Y）为纯实数。

en.name: Resonant frequency
en.when: Ideal series RLC (or ideal parallel GCL); at resonance Z (or Y) is real.

formulas.name: 串联谐振的品质因数
formulas.when: RLC 串联，谐振时；U 为有效值，U̇_L 超前电流 90°，U̇_C 滞后 90°。

en.name: Quality factor (series)
en.when: Series RLC at resonance; rms values, U̇_L leads the current by 90°, U̇_C lags by 90°.

formulas.name: 通频带
formulas.when: 串联 RLC，输出取 R 上电压；ω_1、ω_2 为 |H| = 1/√2 的半功率频率。单位 rad/s，除以 2π 得 Hz。

en.name: Bandwidth
en.when: Series RLC with the output across R; ω_1, ω_2 are the half-power frequencies where |H| = 1/√2. In rad/s; divide by 2π for Hz.

formulas.name: 并联谐振
formulas.when: 理想 GCL 并联，电流源激励；R 为与回路并联的总电阻（含折算的电源内阻）。

en.name: Parallel resonance
en.expr: Q = \frac{R}{ω_0L} = ω_0RC, I_L = I_C = QI_s, BW = \frac{1}{RC}
en.when: Ideal parallel GCL driven by a current source; R is the total resistance across the tank (including a referred source resistance).

formulas.name: 线圈与电容并联谐振
formulas.when: 线圈为 R 与 L 串联，再与 C 并联；按端口阻抗为纯电阻定义谐振，要求 R < \sqrt{L/C}。

en.name: Coil in parallel with a capacitor
en.when: Coil = R in series with L, in parallel with C; resonance defined by a purely resistive port impedance, requires R < \sqrt{L/C}.

formulas.name: L∥C 的阻抗
formulas.when: 理想 L 与 C 并联；ω < 1/\sqrt{LC} 感性，ω > 1/\sqrt{LC} 容性，ω = 1/\sqrt{LC} 时 → ∞。

en.name: Impedance of L∥C
en.when: Ideal L in parallel with C; inductive below 1/\sqrt{LC}, capacitive above, infinite at 1/\sqrt{LC}.

formulas.name: 反相有源滤波器
formulas.when: 理想 op-amp（运算放大器），同相端接地，线性工作区；Z_1 为输入支路阻抗，Z_f 为反馈支路阻抗。

en.name: Inverting active filter
en.when: Ideal op-amp, non-inverting input grounded, linear region; Z_1 input-branch impedance, Z_f feedback-branch impedance.

examples.title: 串联 RLC：谐振、Q 值与通频带
examples.statement: R = 20 Ω，L = 0.2 H，C = 5 µF 串联，U̇_s = 1∠0° V（有效值），电源频率等于谐振频率；输出取电阻电压 U_o。求 f_0、谐振电流 I、U_L 和 U_C、品质因数 Q、两个半功率频率和通频带。
steps: 3. **L、C 上的电压。** U_L = U_C = I × 200 = **10 V**，是电源电压的 10 倍；U̇_C 的相位为 **−90°**，U̇_L 为 +90°，二者抵消。

en.title: Series RLC: resonance, Q and bandwidth
en.statement: R = 20 Ω, L = 0.2 H and C = 5 µF in series, U̇_s = 1∠0° V (rms) at the resonant frequency; the output U_o is the resistor voltage. Find f_0, the current I at resonance, U_L and U_C, the quality factor Q, the two half-power frequencies and the bandwidth.
steps: 2. **Current at resonance.** X_L = ω_0L = 1000 × 0.2 = 200, X_C = 1/(ω_0C) = 200 (in Ω): equal, so Z = R = 20 Ω and I = 1/20 = **0.05 A**, in phase with U_s.
3. **Voltages on L and C.** U_L = U_C = I × 200 = **10 V**, ten times the source voltage; U̇_C has phase **−90°**, U̇_L +90°, so they cancel.
4. **Quality factor.** Q = ω_0L/R = 200/20 = **10** = U_C/U_s.

5. **Half-power frequencies.** |H| = 1/√2 where |ωL − 1/(ωC)| = R, giving ω_{1,2} = ∓R/(2L) + √((R/(2L))² + ω_0²) ≈ 951.2 and 1051.2 (rad/s), i.e. **f_1 ≈ 151.4 Hz**, **f_2 ≈ 167.3 Hz**. Check: ω_1ω_2 = ω_0².
6. **Bandwidth.** BW = ω_2 − ω_1 = R/L; in hertz f_2 − f_1 = R/(2πL) = **15.92 Hz** = f_0/Q.

examples.title: RC 低通加同相放大器：有源低通
examples.statement: R = 1 kΩ、C = 1 µF 组成 RC 低通，电容电压 u_a 送入理想 op-amp（运算放大器）构成的同相放大器（R_1 = 10 kΩ，R_f = 10 kΩ），输出端接负载 R_L = 1 kΩ。U̇_s = 1∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s。求 H(jω) = U̇_o/U̇_s 在该频率下的模、分贝值和相位，以及直流增益和截止频率。

results.ask: 直流增益（ω = 1 rad/s 时 H 的实部）

steps: 1. **RC 部分。** op-amp（运算放大器）同相输入端不取电流（虚断），所以电容右边相当于开路：U̇_a/U̇_s = 1/(1 + jωRC)，ω_c = 1/(RC) = 1/(10³ × 10⁻⁶) = **1000 rad/s**。
2. **同相放大器。** 虚短：u_{−} = u_a，R_1、R_f 分压得 U̇_o = (1 + R_f/R_1)U̇_a = 2U̇_a。
5. **负载不影响 H。** 输出由 op-amp 直接驱动，R_L 取多少 U̇_o 都不变；如果把 R_L 直接接在电容两端（没有 op-amp），截止频率和增益都会改变。

en.title: RC low-pass followed by a non-inverting amplifier: an active low-pass
en.statement: R = 1 kΩ and C = 1 µF form an RC low-pass; the capacitor voltage u_a drives a non-inverting amplifier built with an ideal op-amp (R_1 = 10 kΩ, R_f = 10 kΩ), whose output feeds a load R_L = 1 kΩ. U̇_s = 1∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s. Find the magnitude, dB value and phase of H(jω) = U̇_o/U̇_s at this frequency, the DC gain and the cut-off frequency.

results.ask: DC gain (real part of H at ω = 1 rad/s)

steps: 1. **RC part.** The non-inverting input draws no current (virtual open), so the capacitor is unloaded: U̇_a/U̇_s = 1/(1 + jωRC), ω_c = 1/(RC) = 1/(10³ × 10⁻⁶) = **1000 rad/s**.
2. **Non-inverting amplifier.** Virtual short: u_{−} = u_a, and the divider R_1, R_f gives U̇_o = (1 + R_f/R_1)U̇_a = 2U̇_a.
3. **Network function.** H(jω) = \frac{2}{1 + jω/ω_c}: DC gain **2** (**6.02 dB**), → 0 as ω → ∞ — a first-order active low-pass with **f_c = 159.2 Hz**.
4. **At ω = 1000 rad/s.** Exactly ω = ω_c: H = 2/(1 + j) = 1.414∠**−45°**, 20lg|H| = **3.01 dB**, 3 dB below the DC gain.

5. **The load does not change H.** The op-amp drives the output, so U̇_o is the same for any R_L; with R_L connected straight across the capacitor (no op-amp), both the cut-off and the gain would change.

mistakes.text: 把 ω 和 f 混用：ω_0 = 1/√(LC) 是角频率（rad/s），f_0 = ω_0/(2π) 才是 Hz。带宽同样要看清单位。

en.text: Mixing up ω and f: ω_0 = 1/√(LC) is an angular frequency (rad/s); f_0 = ω_0/(2π) is in Hz. Watch the unit of a bandwidth too.

mistakes.text: 求截止频率时只用了串联的那个 R，忘了负载电阻或其他电阻。τ 里的 R 是从 C（或 L）两端看进去的等效电阻。

en.text: Using only the series R for the cut-off and forgetting the load or other resistors. The R in τ is the equivalent resistance seen from the terminals of C (or L).

mistakes.text: 两节无源 RC 直接级联时把各节单独的 H 相乘。后一节是前一节的负载，要整体计算；只有中间有隔离（跟随器）时才能相乘。

en.text: Multiplying the separate H of two passive RC sections connected directly. The second section loads the first, so compute the whole circuit; multiply only when a buffer isolates them.

mistakes.text: 实际线圈（有电阻）与电容并联时仍用 ω_0 = 1/√(LC)。必须写出导纳令虚部为零，结果比 1/√(LC) 小。

en.text: Using ω_0 = 1/√(LC) for a real (resistive) coil in parallel with a capacitor. Write the admittance and set its imaginary part to zero; the result is below 1/√(LC).

mistakes.text: 以为串联谐振时 L、C 上的电压都是零。它们各自可以是电源电压的 Q 倍，只是相位相反、相加为零。并联谐振时 L、C 的电流同理。

en.text: Thinking the L and C voltages are zero at series resonance. Each can be Q times the source voltage; they are opposite in phase and only their sum is zero. Likewise for the L and C currents at parallel resonance.

mistakes.text: 求并联谐振回路的 Q、带宽时忘了把信号源内阻并进去。有载时 G 应为所有并联电导之和，Q 变小、通带变宽。

en.text: Forgetting the source resistance when finding Q and bandwidth of a parallel tank. Loaded, G is the sum of all parallel conductances, so Q drops and the band widens.
